# Convention checklist
Source checked14October2026: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF
Pseudocode: clear contracts/keywords/indentation, explicit block endings, = assignment versus == comparison, initialised locals, CONST names, zero-based examples, integral midpoint and stated loop bounds. Syntax is guidance, not a mandatory unique grammar. Earlier language-neutral examples remain algorithm explanations; use clinic for convention-focused tasks.
Network: source printedp12 lists component symbols and perimeter firewall placement. Compare symbol artwork visually with source and Cisco reference before signoff. Diagrams must show devices/endpoints/links/prefixes/gateways/security/performance. Visual symbol fidelity remains pending because source rendering was unavailable; no generic icon is certified.
